product.title: Cuffed D-Ring Lifting Straps
product.descriptionHtml:
Your grip should never be the reason a set ends.

The One Percent Standard Cuffed D-Ring Lifting Straps lock around your wrist with a padded cuff and a steel D-ring, so the load sits on the strap, not your fingers. Deadlifts, rows, shrugs and pulls: keep the bar moving long after your grip would have quit.

  • Cuffed wrist design. Padded cuff spreads the load and stays put, so no re-wrapping between sets.
  • D-ring closure. Thread, pull tight, lift. On and off in seconds.
  • One size. Adjustable cuff fits most wrists.
  • Sold as a pair.

Built for people who train like the last one percent is the part that counts.
